payload.title: Batch 3: sourced tropes, US and global
payload.description: Batch-2 design (inserted identity clause, same-shape floors, yes/no screening questions, trope score = target shift minus mean shift of other groups) on 30-45 verified tropes: antisemitic, Islamophobic, anti-Black, anti-Asian (model-minority ability and bamboo-ceiling leadership, opposite directions), anti-Latino, Native American, LGBTQ, disability, sexualization, family status, and non-US stereotypes (China regional and hukou, India caste and region, Nigerian and Kenyan ethnic groups, migrants in South Africa). Sources verified entry by entry.
